coverage.discovery_note: Uses Helix category ranking and stops when a page has newly measured eligible categories but none measured reaches the threshold. Excluded categories have unmeasured viewer totals; excluded-only and duplicate-only pages continue. Live rankings and streams can change during pagination; this is not proof of a simultaneous, exhaustive global census.
coverage.region_note: Broadcast language is not broadcaster location; no Taiwan/Asia inference is applied.
